parsed.explanation: Universal-exposure features dominate: the Nov 2025 Supreme Court-allowed passport/visa sex-marker regime, consular refusal on any sex discrepancy (fraud ground theoretically available), and foreign-government travel advisories make discovery consequential at the border. Facility bans reach roughly 40% of states, criminal in four, with a documented arrest and men's-ward detention; immigration-custody abuse of trans men and conversion-therapy-style prison policies add severity-4 custody risk. Public opinion (66% backing birth-sex documents) signals broad hostility. Offsetting: no trans-specific criminal offence nationally, functioning courts enjoining several orders, hate-crime and employment protections, 29 states with no mapped ban, active litigation and civil society. Worst features are tier-1/tier-2 with partial, imperfect remedy.
